policy.decision: All earlier WWAT captures and replay outputs are quarantined from recovery and frequency-comparison decisions because their aircraft truth can be stale or spatially unbounded.

required_truth.dual_source_disagreement_rule: apply when a second source has an observation within 3 seconds; do not blend disagreeing sources
